metadata.case_name: KWONG KIN YIN v. SHUN LEE COPPER & DECORATION LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Pain and bruising of right elbow (pain in his right elbow / bruised right elbow)
source: the plaintiff complained of injuries to his left wrist and right knee and pain in his right elbow.
In simple terms he was diagnosed with a broken left wrist, sprained right knee and bruised right elbow.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

injuries.description: Fracture of the left distal radius (broken left wrist)
source: An X-ray showed a fracture of the left distal radius with minimal displacement.
In simple terms he was diagnosed with a broken left wrist
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: Right knee injuries: tears of the anterior cruciate ligament, the lateral meniscus and medial collateral ligament; anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction and partial lateral menisectomy performed
source: the plaintiff was diagnosed as having suffered tears of the anterior cruciate ligament, the lateral meniscus and medial collateral ligament.
On 24 February 2006 arthroscopic surgery on his right knee took place and an anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction and a partial lateral menisectomy were performed.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

injuries.description: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) with recurring nightmares, flashbacks and mood symptoms
source: he started receiving psychiatric treatment from United Christian Hospital. He also experienced mood changes, becoming depressive and irritable at times. He was clinically diagnosed as suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder.

“Residual mood symptoms will likely be persisting into considerable time in future. They will probably to some extent impair his power of attention and concentration if he is to be engaged in any sorts of open employment.”

manifestations.description: Episodes of flashback memory of his accident
Mood changes; becoming depressive and irritable at times
Left wrist pain increased on movement and on carrying heavy weights
Right knee pain, especially after walking for more than 30 minutes, and intermittent numbness
Numbness of the medial aspect of the right leg
Power in his left wrist was slightly less than normal
Wasting of the muscles of the right lower limb
Slight decrease of sensation of the upper half of the right leg
Unable to kneel and cannot lift heavy objects (functional limitation reported by plaintiff)

treatments_received: short arm plaster of Paris slab for left arm
physiotherapy (15 sessions pre-op; further 30 sessions post-op)
psychiatric treatment including anti-depressive drugs and supportive psychotherapy
arthroscopic surgery: anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction and partial lateral menisectomy (24 February 2006)
treatments_future: further intensive psychiatric treatment: medication and 16 psychotherapy sessions (recommended by Dr. Singer)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could no longer enjoy social activities such as cycling, hiking, playing badminton and ping pong; avoidance due to psychological fear of getting injured again
Deprived of pursuing a career in the construction/decoration industry and consequent loss of promotion prospects
Residual pain and slightly weakened left wrist; left wrist power slightly less than normal
Residual pain, mild laxity and some wasting in the right knee after anterior cruciate reconstruction; difficulty with walking over 30 minutes and climbing
